card.name: Lead-in to a numeric range or threshold
card.fires_on: The spot just before a number range or cutoff in dosing tables, right after a patient group or lab measure such as eGFR, CLcr, LVEF or an age group. Often a space, 'between', 'of' or 'less'.

modes.label: After a kidney or heart measure
modes.description: Linking word or part of the abbreviation right after eGFR, CLcr or LVEF, before the numeric cutoff.
modes.example: patients with an eGFR<< between>> 30 and 45 mL

modes.label: After a patient group or level
modes.description: Blank space after an age group or lab level, before the range that applies to it.
modes.example: Adults and Pediatric Patients<< >>13 to 17 years:

card.writes: It pushes toward words that state a bound or limit, and away from Chinese words meaning at most, at least or more than.
card.plain: It fires where the text is about to give a number range for a lab value or patient group.
